invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any collision between fixed meta-training world seeds and the runner-random scoring seed.
Invalidate if an implementable candidate receives latent codes, sensor weights, label permutations, hidden targets or unprobed sensor values.
Invalidate unless every sensor access passes through the charged single-use probe interface.
Invalidate if the three source-identical causal roles differ outside meta-world access and preregistered representation learning versus freezing.
Invalidate on post-score tuning, external model or API use, state-budget breach or evaluator-integrity change.

alternative_explanations: The fixed Gaussian likelihood is correctly specified for the generator and meta calibration can only add estimation error and cost.
Any gain may arise from more meta observations rather than a transferable residual representation; the support-only and frozen source-identical roles isolate those accounts.
confounds: The cohort is synthetic and locally visible, so even a positive is not evidence for open-world perception or general intelligence.
With 32 queries per cell, a one-seed 0.03 accuracy contrast has substantial binomial uncertainty and requires unchanged replication.
falsification_criteria: Discard unless shared aggregate accuracy exceeds both source-identical ablations and the strongest complete implementable control by at least 0.03.
Discard unless shared minimum-cell accuracy exceeds both source-identical ablations by at least 0.03 and no cell trails the strongest complete implementable control by more than 0.03125.
Discard if shared is absent from the implementable Pareto frontier or a simpler complete baseline matches its accuracy with no greater complete cost.

Invalidate on changed frozen constants, source mismatch, hidden sensor or target access, meta/test collision, post-score tuning, state breach, semantic-gate failure, preflight mismatch or evaluator-integrity failure.

outcome_policy.negative: Falsify HYP-0042 for this exact rule, preserve the negative and return to a fundamentally different breadth mechanism.
outcome_policy.null: Discard this exact residual binning and probe rule without tuning; retain active probing only as a classical component.
outcome_policy.positive: Authorize only an unchanged three-seed adversarial replication of this exact residual calibration; do not mark promising or promote.

predicted_outcome: Most likely the correctly specified Gaussian or kernel control remains stronger: shared calibration may improve support-only at large K but will fail the frozen 0.03 aggregate margin and be full-cost dominated.
promotion_criteria: This one-seed scout cannot promote; a positive may only authorize an unchanged three-seed adversarial successor.
Replication authorization additionally requires the shared 0.03 aggregate and minimum-cell margins, all mandatory controls complete and implementable Pareto non-dominance.
research_question: Does an invariant residual likelihood learned across earlier raw-sensor worlds improve adaptive identification in an unseen transformed world over support-only and frozen classical likelihoods at full cost?
title: Meta-learned residual likelihood for active raw-sensor probing
